entries.title: Alogy glass
entries.summary: Merged and confirmed groups using Alogy glass listings that name several models, including Nokia 6.2/7.2, vivo Y11s/Y20s, vivo Y21s/Y33s, Redmi 10X 4G/Note 9 and Realme 12 Pro/12 Pro+.

entries.title: Accezz and Selencia glass
entries.summary: Merged and confirmed groups using Accezz, Selencia and imoshion glass from Smartphonehoesjes.nl that names several models, including Nokia G10/G11/G20/G21/G22, Oppo A58/A79/A98, Oppo A17/A18/A38, Moto G31/G41/G71 and Oppo A74/A94 5G.

entries.title: Spigen India and GSMpunt glass
entries.summary: Merged and confirmed groups using Spigen India and GSMpunt (Rosso, Buddi, OtterBox, Spigen) listings that sell one glass for several models, including Galaxy A50/M21/M31, M21/M30/M30s, Oppo A16/A16s/A54s and Realme GT 7/GT 7T.

entries.title: POPIO glass
entries.summary: Merged and confirmed groups using POPIO edge-to-edge glass listings that name several models, including Galaxy A71/M51/M55, Redmi Note 9 Pro/9S/Poco X2, vivo Y90-Y95, Oppo A11/A15/A16 and Realme 5/5i/5s.

entries.title: Deltaco, Linocell and Tech-Protect glass
entries.summary: Merged and confirmed groups using Deltaco, Linocell (Kjell & Company) and Tech-Protect product pages that sell one glass for several models, including Galaxy A02-A04s/A12/A32 5G, Redmi Note 15 Pro 5G/17 Pro and Moto G15/G17/G05/E15.

entries.title: PanzerGlass glass
entries.summary: Merged and confirmed groups using PanzerGlass product pages that sell one glass for several models, including Oppo Reno13/Reno14/Reno14 F, Galaxy M56/S25 FE, Xiaomi 17 Pro Max/17 Ultra and Huawei Pura 80 Pro/Pro+/Ultra.

entries.title: SBS and Cellularline glass
entries.summary: Merged and confirmed groups using SBS and Cellularline product pages that sell one glass for several models, including Oppo Reno11/Reno11 Pro, Galaxy A51/A51 5G, Xiaomi Mi 11/Mi 11 Pro and Moto G9 Play/E7 Plus/G8 Power Lite.

models: Honor Magic V2 RSR Porsche Design

entries.title: Hama and Displex glass
entries.summary: Merged and confirmed groups using Hama and Displex product pages that sell one glass for several models, including Galaxy S24 FE/S25 FE, A22/A31/A32, A02/A03 and Motorola Edge 70 Plus/Pro/Fusion.

entries.title: 3MK and Spacecase glass
entries.summary: Merged and confirmed groups using 3MK and Spacecase listings that sell one glass for several models, including vivo Y16/Y22s, Galaxy M31s/S20 FE and Realme 7 Pro/8/8 Pro.

entries.title: FIXED and MP.cz glass
entries.summary: FIXED's own shop and MP.cz (PanzerGlass, Caliber) list one glass for several models. 15 merges, including Galaxy S22/S23, Find X8/X9 Ultra, Realme 12/12x/13 with C65/Narzo, Realme C61/C63/Note 60, Edge 50/60 Neo, Redmi Pad Pro/Poco Pad, Tab S9-S11 Ultra, plus more confirmed groups.

entries.title: Hurtel multi-model glass
entries.summary: Glass listings from 3MK, Tech-Protect, Wozinsky, Spigen and Ringke (via Hurtel) merged the Galaxy A05 and A06 groups, Pixel 10/10 Pro with Pixel 11/11 Pro, Redmi Note 15 Pro with Note 17 Pro/Pro Max, and Infinix Note 50 with Note 50 Pro, and confirmed more shared groups.

entries.title: New label: Same model
entries.summary: 129 unverified groups whose models are one device in region, carrier, SIM or connectivity versions (Duos, LTE, Wi-Fi, USA and so on, bodies within 1 mm) now show a Same model badge. No codes changed.

entries.title: Supershieldz multi-model glass
entries.summary: Checked Supershieldz's 1,355 tempered-glass products: merged the Black Shark 4/4 Pro into the Poco F3/Redmi K40 group, the Moto G50 with the G30, the Nord 2 5G with the Nord CE 5G, the Mi CC9e with the Mi A3, the Tab S2 9.7 with the Tab S3 9.7 and the Galaxy S20 5G UW and A71 5G UW with their base models, and confirmed several Huawei nova, Redmi, OnePlus 8T and Nokia C10/C20 pairs.

entries.title: Homescreen.pl glass listings: Xiaomi, Motorola, Oppo, Realme, Samsung
entries.summary: Checked about 4,300 glass listings at Homescreen.pl (Bizon, 3MK, MyScreen, PanzerGlass, Tech-Protect and others) against the catalogue: 60 new findings that merge or confirm groups, mostly Xiaomi/Redmi/Poco, Motorola G and E, Oppo A and Realme, plus Galaxy A22/M22, A80/A90 and Xperia 10 VII/VIII.

entries.title: OnePlus 10R/10T and Galaxy Watch8 44mm merges
entries.summary: Merged the OnePlus 10R and 10T groups, and added the Galaxy Watch8 44mm to the Watch6/Watch7 44mm group (PanzerGlass).

entries.title: PanzerGlass shared-glass merges
entries.summary: Merged the Galaxy S22+/S23+, Z Fold4/Fold5, OnePlus 9 Pro/10 Pro/11, Nord 3/4, Edge 60/60 Pro/60 Fusion, Xiaomi 17 Pro Max/17 Ultra, and Redmi Note 13 Pro with the Poco X6 Pro; confirmed the Xperia 10 V/10 VI.

entries.title: Motorola and Honor groups checked
entries.summary: PanzerGlass's own listings merge the Moto G84 with the G72 and the Edge 50 Pro with the Edge 50 Ultra (curved screens), and confirm the Honor 600 / 600 Pro group.

entries.title: Oppo groups checked
entries.summary: The Oppo A38 / A18 group is confirmed: Just In Case sells one glass for both.

entries.title: Galaxy Tab groups checked
entries.summary: The Galaxy Tab S10 FE+ (Samsung's own protector) and Tab A8 10.5 (SaharaCase glass) are confirmed in their own groups.

entries.title: iPhone 16 Pro Max confirmed
entries.summary: Belkin sells UltraGlass 2 made for the iPhone 16 Pro Max and a separate one for the 17 and 18 Pro Max, so the 16 Pro Max is confirmed in its own group.

entries.title: Xiaomi groups checked
entries.summary: The Redmi 12C / Poco C55 group is confirmed: Hurtel and Elkjøp each sell one glass for both.

entries.title: Apple Watch groups checked
entries.summary: The Apple Watch SE 3 40mm and 44mm join the Series 4-6 / SE groups (MediaDevil makes one protector per size for all of them). The Series 12 42mm has its own glass: Spigen's is only compatible with it.

entries.title: OnePlus groups checked
entries.summary: Confirmed three OnePlus twins sold under two names: 12R / Ace 3 (PanzerGlass), 13R / Ace 5 / Ace 5 Pro (Nillkin) and 10T / Ace Pro (Cadorabo).

entries.title: Motorola groups checked
entries.summary: The Moto G85 joins the Edge 50 Fusion (PanzerGlass sells one glass for both), and the Razr+ 2026 and Razr 70+ join the Razr+ 2024/2025 group (ZAGG sells one cover-screen protector for the 2024, 2025 and 2026 models).

entries.title: Galaxy A series groups checked
entries.summary: The Galaxy A18 joins the A16/A17 group: Coolblue's BlueBuilt glass lists the A17 4G, A17 5G and A18. Samsung and PanzerGlass glass confirms the A27 and A33 5G on their own.

entries.title: Google Pixel groups checked
entries.summary: Pixel 11 Pro XL joins the Pixel 9 Pro XL and 10 Pro XL group: Spigen sells glass listed for all three. Pixel 7 Pro, Pixel Fold, Pixel Tablet and Pixel 11 / 11 Pro are now confirmed from Google Store, Spigen and PanzerGlass listings.

entries.title: Galaxy Note, S10 and Z-series groups checked
entries.summary: The Galaxy Note10+ and Note10+ 5G group is confirmed: Gadget Guard and SaharaCase each sell one protector for both.

entries.title: Galaxy S20 and S21 groups checked
entries.summary: The S20 FE 2022 is a re-release of the S20 FE 5G (model SM-G781NK), so the S20 FE group is confirmed. The Verizon S20 5G UW keeps its own group with a test-first note: same screen as the S20 5G, but ZAGG sells UW-specific glass.

entries.title: Galaxy S20 Ultra group confirmed
entries.summary: The Galaxy S20 Ultra and S20 Ultra 5G are the same phone (model SM-G988B/DS listed for both), so their group is confirmed and now carries the curved-screen fit note. The S21 Ultra stays separate: smaller 6.8in screen and a shorter body.

entries.title: Galaxy S24, S25 and S26 groups checked
entries.summary: All Galaxy S24, S25 and S26 groups are now confirmed except the S25 FE group's F56. Spigen sells S24/S25 glass together and S26-only glass; PanzerGlass sells S25 FE glass with the M56 and different glass for the S24 FE; Cellularline adds the A57 and S26 FE to the S25 FE.

entries.title: Galaxy S26+ has its own glass
entries.summary: The S26+ leaves the S24+/S25+ group: Spigen sells its S24+/S25+ glass for those two only and its S26+ glass for the S26+ alone, even though the bodies measure the same. Both groups are now confirmed.

entries.title: Apple and Samsung groups checked
entries.summary: Brand listings merged 11 groups: iPhone 14 Pro Max with 15 Plus and 16 Plus (Belkin); Galaxy A71, Note10 Lite, M51, F62, M62 and M52 5G (Nillkin); A12 with A32 5G (articona, cellhelmet); A53 5G with the A52s (PanzerGlass); S24 FE with A36 and A56 (PanzerGlass); A57 and S26 FE with S25 FE (Cellularline); Z Fold8 Ultra with Z Fold7 and Z Flip8 with Z Flip7 (Spigen). Apple Watch and Galaxy Watch sizes filled in from GSMArena.

entries.title: Garmin fenix 9 groups split by screen
entries.summary: The fenix 9 Pro Solar 47mm has a smaller MIP screen than the AMOLED 47mm models, and the three 51mm models each have a different screen (fenix 9 1.4in AMOLED, 9 Pro 1.5in AMOLED, 9 Pro Solar MIP), so each gets its own group. The base fenix 9 51mm now points to 36mm universal glass, not 38mm.

entries.title: Groups with mismatched sizes split
entries.summary: A size check found models grouped together that are different sizes: two pairs of old Samsung phones sharing a name (Galaxy Beam, Galaxy), Allview Viva H8 / H8 LTE, BLU Studio 7.0 / 7.0 LTE, Gear S2 classic / classic 3G, three Prestigio MultiPad 7.0 Prime bodies, and Garmin vivomove 3S / Style and 3 / Luxe. Each now has its own group. The vivo T5 moves from the iQOO Z11 group to the Y31d group, which matches its specs.

models: Galaxy S II Skyrocket HD I757
I8200 Galaxy S III mini VE

entries.title: Surface Go and Amazfit Balance 2 groups checked
entries.summary: Amazfit Active 3 Premium moved out of the Balance 2 group: Amazfit's specs give it a smaller screen and case. Balance 2 XT joined the Balance 2 group. The Surface Go group stays as is, with a Targus source and a note to buy glass listed for the Go 2 or later.

entries.title: Screen and body sizes for about 1,000 more models
entries.summary: Sizes added for watches, handhelds, e-readers, tablets, iPods and new phones, from maker spec pages and spec sites. Foldables now show their cover screen and folded body. Ordinary flip phones and the Zenfone 8 Flip are no longer marked as cover-screen-only foldables, and the Oppo Find N, Honor Magic Vs and Huawei Pura X foldables now are. No codes changed.

entries.title: iPhone 12 mini and 13 mini need different glass
entries.summary: Checked whether the two minis share glass: brands sell separate glass for each, so they stay in their own groups. No codes changed.

entries.title: Galaxy A54 and S23 FE share glass
entries.summary: Four brands sell one glass for both phones, so their groups are merged and confirmed.

entries.title: Bug fixes: source links and a merged Motorola tablet
entries.summary: Fixed 100 broken 3MK source links. The Motorola DROID XYBOARD 8.2 now shares a group with the XOOM 2 Media Edition, which it is a Verizon version of; a stray space in its name had kept them apart.

entries.title: Gap check: new releases, missing models and missed fit groups
entries.summary: Added 120 models released since the July 2026 catalogue snapshot (phones, tablets, watches, e-readers and handhelds) plus a few the snapshot missed, such as the Surface Duo and Duo 2. Groups that sellers and compatibility charts show share glass were merged, including iPhone 14 Pro with iPhone 15 and 16.

entries.title: Second verification round, model numbers and fit tags
entries.summary: Four more research passes checked Samsung, handheld, wearable and other-brand groups, adding confirmations, merges and splits with source links. Apple's official model numbers were added for iPads, Apple Watches and iPods, and groups now carry fit tags and screen sizes.

models: Asus ROG Phone 6 Diablo Immortal Edition

entries.title: Fit groups checked against seller listings
entries.summary: Nine research passes checked fit groups against protector brands, retailers and marketplaces. Groups that sellers show share glass were merged, ones that need different glass were split, and 190 more groups were confirmed, each with source links.

entries.summary: 9,139 fit groups covering 12,217 models from 157 brands, built from the GSMArena catalogue and hand-researched lists. 81 groups confirmed by sellers.
